newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar ends flat despite U.S. dollar rise.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar ends flat despite U.S. dollar rise.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar closed unchanged against its American counterpart on Monday despite the U.S. dollar's rise overseas, dealers said.
The local unit ended at T$27.493, the same as Saturday's close, after trading within a narrow T$27.493-27.496 range.
Turnover through dealers was a thin US$116 million. Dealers said they saw only commercial demand and supply on Monday.
"Nobody entered to take risks because they can make no money," said one dealer. "Only some banks entered to square their commercial positions."

Year-end U.S. dollar demand could emerge at any time in coming sessions, but dealers said the Taiwan dollar was likely to continue to trade in a stable range through the end of 1996 due to abundant U.S. dollar supply.
A T$27.49-27.50 range was seen for Tuesday.
